content: For optimal effectiveness, this medication should be used in conjunction with a doctor-approved exercise program and diet plan. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if more than 1 to 2 hours have passed since your meal, skip the missed dose, as most of the fat from your meal will already have been absorbed, rendering the medication ineffective. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Avoid flushing medications down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Before starting orlistat, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. If you have diabetes, weight loss may improve your blood sugar control. Regularly monitor your blood sugar levels and share the results with your doctor. This medication must not be used during pregnancy, as weight loss offers no benefit to a pregnant woman and may harm the unborn baby. It is unknown whether this drug passes into breast milk. Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. If you are taking medications to treat seizures, orlistat may reduce their effectiveness. In the event of an overdose with serious symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Laboratory tests, such as kidney function tests, may be conducted while you are taking this medication. This information is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. It is not a substitute for individualized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs. For formulary information, create a list of plans to compare the status of this drug with others in the same class. Individual plans may vary, and formulary information is subject to change. Contact the applicable plan provider for the most current details.
